title: /sprint-start spawns subagent_type=<role>, which fails where .claude/agents/ is not installed; drive falls back to the packaged spec, the manual path does not
detail: In the engine repo (no .claude/agents/), /sprint-start step 2 Agent(subagent_type=brief-critic) errors 'Agent type not found'. drive._agent_spec (drive.py:205) falls back to prusik/templates/.claude/agents/<role>.md; the manual command path has no fallback, so the operator hand-rolls a general-purpose agent reading the spec. That stand-in has no tools: Read, Write limit and a bigger system prompt (~47-52k tokens per brief-critic round on haiku vs the spec's own '<5k tokens').
